# NamasteQR - Restaurant & Hotel Management Portal

> NamasteQR (https://namasteqr.com) is an all-in-one restaurant and hotel operations portal featuring contact-free digital QR menus, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), waiter station monitors, billing & POS register, secure Email OTP table check-ins, and thermal receipt printing.

## Core Features & Public Links
- [NamasteQR Portal](https://namasteqr.com): Official portal homepage for hospitality businesses.
- [Merchant Registration](https://namasteqr.com/signup): Onboard and configure your restaurant or hotel.
- [Staff & Admin Login](https://namasteqr.com/login): Access POS, KDS, inventory, and restaurant operations.
